access_note: The own page says open sharing and CC BY 4.0 and offers a Download button; download access was not tested. DataCite API has no entry for this DOI. The page names an ESRI Shapefile but its geometry and attribute table were not inspected.
description: The Loess Science Data Center publishes a 2024 map of photovoltaic panel arrays in Xinjiang, Qinghai, Gansu, Ningxia and Shaanxi. The producing team classified Sentinel-2 imagery and reports a 10-metre mapping product with an overall accuracy of 91.6 percent and Kappa of 0.89. The own page identifies DOI 10.12262/lsdc.17040.2541, an ESRI Shapefile, open sharing and CC BY 4.0. An electricity-system modeller could use array footprints to locate generation sites for spatial exposure scenarios or compare development patterns with grid plans. These polygons represent detected panel area, not installed megawatts, electrical connections, ownership or operating status. The page gives a 2024 data period and a later metadata update in August 2026; the update is not evidence of newer mapped assets. The mapped extent is limited to five northwestern provincial areas, and image classification errors may affect small or shaded sites. The download button and file body were not tested, so geometry, attributes and coordinate system remain unverified. A catalogued China solar-panel and aerosol product gives a related exposure context but is a separate dataset.
name: Dataset of Photovoltaic Panel Arrays in Northwestern Spatial China in 2024
